facts.text: The video is presented as a side-by-side split-screen comparison above a black bottom bar displaying 'your sentence, sent raw' on the left and 'compiled by open-h3-ir' on the right.

In the left panel, a woman with dark hair tied in a top knot undercut and wearing a dark tactical jacket and pants walks toward the camera along a wet, rain-slicked walkway bordered by metal railings on the right and a dark building on the left, with a night city skyline behind her.
As the clip progresses in the left panel, the camera circles smoothly around the woman's right side until she is seen from behind facing down the rainy walkway alongside a dimly lit building.
In the right panel, the same woman initially walks away from the camera in a rear view along a wet walkway between metal railings and a dark building with warm window light.

Partway through the video, the right panel cuts to a close-up left-profile shot of the woman looking downward with rain falling around her and blurred city lights in the background, before she slightly raises and turns her gaze toward the left.
